description: Dark-themed screenshot from a Q-drop aggregator app showing Q post 2611, titled 'JFK Jr. is Not Alive', dated 12 Dec 2018. An embedded anonymous 8chan post asks whether JFK Jr. is alive, and the Q reply answers 'No.' The screenshot documents Q directly denying the JFK Jr.-is-alive theory.

description: Candid paparazzi-style photograph outside a modern high-rise entrance. A man in sunglasses, dark jacket and grey trousers, consistent with Hunter Biden (the archived filename is hunter_biden.jpg), leans on the rear of a white Porsche Panamera GTS holding a boot, with a pink slip resembling a parking ticket on the rear window. A smiling blonde woman in a black sweater and leopard-print trousers stands nearby; a man in dark clothing and cap walks behind her. The license plate is blurred.
flags: Identification of the man as Hunter Biden is consistent with his appearance and the archived filename but not confirmed by any in-image caption
The woman and background man are not identified and may be private individuals

description: Photograph of a face-mask box's warning label, annotated with a hand-drawn red arrow and red underlines emphasizing the disclaimer that the ear-loop mask is not a respirator and will not protect against COVID-19. Images like this circulated as arguments against mask mandates; the label is a standard liability disclaimer for non-respirator general-purpose masks. The bottom bullet list is partially cut off.
text: WARNING:. THIS PRODUCT IS AN EAR LOOP MASK. THIS PRODUCT IS NOT A RESPIRATOR AND WILL NOT PROVIDE ANY PROTECTION AGAINST COVID-19(CORONAVIRUS) OR OTHER VIRUSES OR CONTAMINANTS. Wearing an ear loop mask does not reduce the risk of contracting any disease or infection. User is solely responsible for the selection of appropriate personal protective equipment for the setting and application. Change immediately if contaminated. Made of Soft Material. General Purpose Use Only. Latex Free. 50 Masks
flags: Shared as an anti-mask claim; the label is a manufacturer liability disclaimer, not evidence about mask efficacy in general

description: Mobile screenshot of qmap.pub showing Q post 3954, titled 'One Big Happy Family: The Democrat Party and Mainstream Media', dated 14 Apr 2020. The drop embeds an infographic pairing Democratic administration officials with journalists it says are their relatives — e.g. Susan Rice/Ian Cameron (married), Ben and David Rhodes (brothers), Jay Carney/Claire Shipman (married), Valerie Jarrett/Laura Jarrett (mother and daughter), Andrew and Chris Cuomo (brothers) — to claim family ties between the Democratic Party and mainstream media. Q's caption adds 'Missing [29] connections - National' and 'Missing [98] connections - Local'.
